usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank euro reference rate (USD)
usdRate.note: EUR 1 = USD 1.1172 on 30 October 2026, so about EUR 0.895 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.885.

inflation_cpi.note: NIC index +5.4% year on year in October 2026 (HICP +5.6%), up from 4.2% in September, driven by energy; World Bank 2025 average 1.5%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% medium-term target; ISTAT NIC 5.4% (Oct 2026) after 1.5% in 2025 (World Bank)
inflation_projection.note: Italy uses the euro, so the ECB 2% target anchors long-run inflation; 2.2% allows for the current energy shock fading slowly.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, key ECB interest rates (deposit facility)
policy_rate.note: Italy uses the euro; ECB deposit facility rate 2.50% (main refinancing 2.65%) since 16 September 2026, unchanged on 31 October 2026 (ECB data portal FM.D.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Italian banks, household overnight deposits (new business)
savings_account_rate.note: Average rate on household overnight deposits at Italian banks, 0.20% in August 2026; online deposit accounts pay more. Interest taxed at 26%.

fdr_3m_rate.note: ECB and Banca d'Italia MFI statistics publish household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year as one bucket (2.46% in August 2026); no separate 3-month term deposit rate was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Italian banks, household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Bucket covers all fixed terms (conti deposito vincolati) up to one year; interest taxed at 26%.

dps_rate.note: Italian banks do not offer a standard monthly recurring deposit; regular saving is done through fund accumulation plans (PAC) or by buying postal savings bonds periodically. No published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Italian banks, household deposits with agreed maturity (outstanding amounts)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate on all outstanding household term deposits; overnight deposits, which hold most savings, pay about 0.2%. World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no recent figure for Italy.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: MEF Dipartimento del Tesoro, BTP Valore October 2026 final coupons
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Retail-only 5-year BTP Valore (27 Oct 2026 to 27 Oct 2031): coupons 3.75% in years 1-2, 4.20% in years 3-4, 4.75% in year 5, about 4.13% a year on average; the BTP Valore Insieme twin pays a single 22.70% coupon at maturity. Issued periodically, not on continuous sale.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Secondary-market yield on 3-month Treasury bills (BOT); the Treasury mainly auctions 6- and 12-month BOT.

tbond_10y_rate.note: ECB long-term (10-year) convergence yield for Italy was 4.36% in September 2026 (ECB IRS.M.IT.L.L40.CI.0000.EUR.N.Z).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Agenzia delle Entrate, Circolare 19/E of 27 June 2014 (taxation of financial income)
tax_bank_interest.note: 26% withholding on bank and postal deposit interest since 1 July 2014, still in force in 2026 (PwC Tax Summaries also gives 26% for most financial income); source document is older than 2025.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: Agenzia delle Entrate, Circolare 19/E of 27 June 2014 (taxation of financial income)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Interest on Italian government securities (BTP, BOT, BTP Valore) and postal savings bonds stays taxed at 12.5%; source document is older than 2025 but the rate is unchanged in 2026.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Fondo Interbancario di Tutela dei Depositi (FITD), Garanzia dei depositanti
deposit_insurance_limit.note: EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank, repaid within 7 working days; EU-wide limit.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: Banca d'Italia, usury thresholds valid 1 October to 31 December 2026
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Legal usury ceiling for credit card financing (average rate 12.15%); revolving credit ceiling 24.50% (average 16.50%). Ceilings are reset every quarter.

equity_return_low.sourceName: FTSE MIB 49,474 on 30 Oct 2026 (Trading Economics); BTP 5-year 3.94% before 12.5% tax
equity_return_low.note: Low case: Italian shares, a bank- and energy-heavy market, earn about the after-tax government bond rate, as in 2000-2016.

equity_return_base.sourceName: FTSE MIB (Trading Economics); BTP 5-year 3.94% before 12.5% tax = 3.45% after tax
equity_return_base.note: The FTSE MIB roughly tripled from about 17,000 in late 2016, but the base is held to the after-tax safe rate of about 3.5% plus 3 points, as a diversified fund would earn.

equity_return_high.sourceName: FTSE MIB (Trading Economics); long-run global equity returns
equity_return_high.note: High case: a diversified equity fund matching the strong last decade of Italian and global shares, about 8-9% a year in euros.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, down 3% on a year (Trading Economics)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely keeps up after the 2025-26 spike, with no help from the euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); ECB 2% inflation target
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises roughly with world inflation plus a little, and the euro is assumed stable against the dollar over the long run.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in euro terms.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings stay in term deposits taxed at 26%.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: 1-year deposits 1.8% after tax; BTP Valore about 4.13% less 12.5% tax = 3.6%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of term deposits and retail government bonds, which are taxed at only 12.5%.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BTP Valore October 2026 about 4.13% a year less 12.5% tax = 3.6%
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in 5-year retail government bonds at today's coupons.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: IVASS publishes complaint and market statistics but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life (assicurazione temporanea caso morte, TCM) is widely sold, but no published premium table per EUR 1,000 of cover by age from IVASS or another public body was found; comparison sites were not used.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Hospital care is free at the point of use in the Servizio Sanitario Nazionale; no official figure for the typical out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Private health policies are sold per plan (reimbursement ceilings, age), not per sum insured, and no age-banded premium table per EUR 100,000 of cover was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: ISTAT CPI September 2026: health (Sanità) +1.3% a year
goal_inflation_health.note: Measured health prices rise below headline inflation, but private visits and diagnostics outside the public system tend to rise faster, so 2.5% is used.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: ISTAT CPI September 2026: education services +1.4% a year
goal_inflation_education.note: Public schooling and university fees are low and regulated, so education costs are assumed to rise slightly above the 2% ECB target.

life_expectancy.note: Men 81.7, women 85.7 in 2025 (ISTAT estimate); total 83.7 from ISTAT's 2026 health indicators. UN WPP gives 84.2 for 2026 and the World Bank 84.0 for 2024.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP mid-year estimate for 2026); ISTAT gives 19.7 (men) and 22.6 (women) at 65 for 2024.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 39.7 (2025, World Bank), 61.8 (2040) and 68.0 (2065, populationpyramid.net/italy/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: INPS, pension requirements updated for 2027 and 2028
retirement_age_default.note: Old-age pension (pensione di vecchiaia) age is 67 in 2026, 67 and 1 month in 2027 and 67 and 3 months from 2028, the same for men and women, with 20 years of contributions; it is linked to life expectancy, so people born after 1975 (who reach 67 after 2042) are likely to face a later age.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: INPS, pension requirements updated for 2027 and 2028 (public and private employees)
retirement_age_government.note: Public employees reach the old-age pension at the same age (67 in 2026, rising by 1 month in 2027 and 3 months in 2028); press reports (not read in full here) say the Budget Law 2025 moved the public-sector compulsory retirement limit from 65 to this age.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates fall back if the ECB cuts.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: 3-month BOT 2.65% less 12.5% tax = 2.3% (Trading Economics); 1-year deposits 1.8% after tax
retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped at the after-tax Treasury bill rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BTP Valore about 4.13% a year less 12.5% tax = 3.6% (MEF)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a retiree ladders retail government bonds at today's coupons.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: BTP 5-year 3.94% before tax (Trading Economics); equity low case 3.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Fixed income base 2.8% after tax; equity base 6.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 6.5% and half safe fixed income at about 2.8% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: BTP Valore 3.6% after tax; equity high 8.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: EUR 546.24 a month paid 13 times a year in 2026 (EUR 7,101.12 a year, shown here as 546.24 x 13 / 12); means-tested and reduced by the claimant's own income; requires 10 years' continuous legal residence.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: From 67 for men and women in 2026 (67 and 1 month in 2027); income below EUR 7,101.12 a year for a single person (EUR 14,202.24 for a couple); effective residence in Italy and 10 years' legal residence.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: INPS, TFR example (domestic workers); Civil Code art. 2120
gratuity_rule.note: Trattamento di fine rapporto (TFR): each year the employer sets aside annual pay / 13.5, paid on any termination (retirement, resignation or dismissal); with the usual 13 monthly salaries that is 13/13.5 of a month, about 28.9 days a year. Past accruals are revalued yearly by 1.5% plus 75% of inflation rather than recalculated on the last wage, and may be paid into a pension fund instead.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: INPS, pension requirements updated for 2027 and 2028
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory earnings-related pension (Assicurazione generale obbligatoria) run by INPS: employees contribute 33% of pay (about 9.19% employee share); the old-age pension needs 20 years of contributions and is paid from 67 (67 and 3 months from 2028); pensions are indexed yearly to prices (perequazione) and are taxable income.

savings_account.note: Current accounts pay almost nothing; free deposit accounts and postal savings books pay more. Interest taxed at 26%; a stamp duty of 0.2% a year applies to deposit accounts.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit; savers use fund accumulation plans (piani di accumulo, PAC) instead.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Retail-only government bond issued a few times a year by the Treasury, with step-up coupons and interest taxed at 12.5%; State-guaranteed postal savings bonds (buoni fruttiferi postali) are a continuously sold alternative.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned mainly at 6 and 12 months; individuals can bid through their bank; interest taxed at 12.5%.

equity_fund.note: Gains taxed at 26%; long-term individual savings plans (PIR) can be tax-exempt after 5 years.

gold.note: Legal to buy and exempt from VAT; gains taxed at 26%.

centralBank.name: Banca d'Italia
centralBank.note: Part of the Eurosystem; monetary policy set by the European Central Bank.

insuranceRegulator.name: IVASS (Istituto per la Vigilanza sulle Assicurazioni)

insuranceComplaints.name: IVASS complaints; Arbitro Assicurativo
insuranceComplaints.note: Complain to the insurer first; after 45 days or an unsatisfactory reply, go to IVASS or the Arbitro Assicurativo (operating since 15 January 2026, www.arbitroassicurativo.org).

publicHealthCover.name: Servizio Sanitario Nazionale (Ministero della Salute)
publicHealthCover.note: Universal public health service; small co-payments (ticket) for some visits, tests and medicines.

depositInsurance.name: Fondo Interbancario di Tutela dei Depositi (FITD)
depositInsurance.note: Cooperative banks are covered by the Fondo di Garanzia dei Depositanti del Credito Cooperativo, with the same EUR 100,000 limit.
